name: Death Everywhere, So Save Paranoiacally 2
storyline: Nagi was kidnapped, and both Blue and Erinog are on a mission to find him. But instead, in the forest, they found another light spirit named Kapi.
summary:
You are not a hero, you are not a warrior... you're just a child.

Join Blue in this coming of rage story, where the forest doesn't just hate him—it wants him erased. Just a single mistake—a step in the wrong direction or a moment of weakness will cause instantaneous death.
